name: Issue a labsheet, and hold the freezer space
description: hand a compiled packet over to somebody — choose a well for every tube it will make and put a hold on it, so two experiments issued the same afternoon cannot take the same spot. This is the act that has consequences; compiling has none
phrases: hand the labsheet to a student

requires.note: prints by default; --write places the holds
spotsNeeded, issue, resolve — the three phases
hold, release, isAvailable — a hold is not a sample

returns: a well held for every tube, written to holds.tsv, and an issue record that c6-receive resolves against. No box file is touched.
notes: PLANNING HAS NO CONSEQUENCES; ISSUING DOES. An experiment gets revised and every revision recompiles, so if compiling reserved space a morning's thinking would leave holds nobody placed deliberately and nobody knows to release. It prints by default and writes only when told. A box named by a step and defined nowhere is PROPOSED here and created only on receipt — see labsheet.receive.
